tei:div.tei:p: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku'i zhing khams pad+mo bde ba can// 'chi med mgon po snang ba mtha' yas la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ longs sku'i rtsal snang rā ga rak+ta'i phug /gu ru blo ldan mchog sred zung 'jug skur// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ sprul sku'i sgrub gnas brag dmar g.ya' ma lung// 'gro 'dren sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ ār+ya pā lo dbang chen pho brang na// 'chi med yongs grub rje 'bangs grogs gsum la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ zag med 'ja' tshon 'chi med ke'u tshang na// zab gter sgo 'byed bde ba'i rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ 'og min bde ba chen po'i pho brang na// bo dhi badz+ra gu ru dharmen+dar// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ yid dga' chos 'dzin pad+ma 'od phung 'khyil// dharmā ka ra tsit+tā badz+ra la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ ye shes klong yangs bde chen 'khor lo na// pad+ma nyin byed rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ zla gam tshe yi dkyil 'khor chen po na// gar dbang rtsa gsum dril sgrub lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so ā= yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ ye shes dbyings dang dam tshig gnas mchog na// bstan srung gtso mo dbang gi lha mo la// gsol ba 'debs so ā yuḥsid+dhi hrīḥ byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badz+ra hoḥ

snod bcud brtan g.yo'i tshe dpal dngos grub kun// bhūm̐ nṛ dzaḥyis yum gyi mkha' ru bskyil// dwangs ma'i 'od zer srog gi snying por bstims// mi 'gyur mi shigs tshe yi dbang mchog thob// snyigs ma'i lus ngag 'od kyi snying po can// na tsha bsgres rgud mi dmigs bde ba che// stong gsal 'ja' tshon sgyu ma chu zla ltar// tshe dbang rig 'dzin go 'phang e ma ho//
bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'chi med dril sgrub kyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang chos rje gling pas bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
